name: hedgehog
tagline_zh: 受够了AI乱改代码？刺猬工作流用BMAD约束每一步，像刺一样扎住关键点，让AI只动该动的，不碰不该碰的。
tagline_en: Tired of AI messing up your code? Hedgehog pins down the critical points with BMAD, so AI only touches what it.
desc_en: An opinionated AI software engineering workflow built for BMAD
why_zh: 它把AI工程流程固化成可执行的规则，而非空谈原则，每次改动都经过严格校验，比同类更稳更可控。
why_en: It turns AI engineering discipline into executable rules, not principles, with strict checks on every change—more stable and.
